description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 with reference to the heading Minister of Finance and Mass Media
reasoning: This gazette content involves a constitutional amendment to a previous notification, specifically modifying the list of subjects and functions assigned to a ministry by adding the Right to Information Commission. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and modifications to existing legal frameworks, falling under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes).
